# IMultiRewarder

## IMultiRewarder
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/stargate/IMultiRewarder.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IRewarder](./i-rewarder.md)

**Title:**
IMultiRewarder

A rewarder that can distribute multiple reward tokens (ERC20 and native) to `StargateStaking` pools.

The native token is encoded as 0x0.


### Functions
#### setReward

Sets the reward for `rewards` of `rewardToken` over `duration` seconds, starting at `start`. The actual
reward over this period will be increased by any rewards on the pool that haven't been distributed yet.


```solidity
function setReward(address rewardToken, uint256 rewards, uint48 start, uint48 duration) external payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The reward token to configure|
|`rewards`|`uint256`|The total reward amount to distribute over the period|
|`start`|`uint48`|The start time of the emission|
|`duration`|`uint48`|The emission duration in seconds|


#### extendReward

Extends the reward duration for `rewardToken` by `amount` tokens, extending the duration by the
equivalent time according to the `rewardPerSec` rate of the pool.


```solidity
function extendReward(address rewardToken, uint256 amount) external payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The reward token to extend|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The additional reward amount to add|


#### setAllocPoints

Configures allocation points for a reward token over multiple staking tokens, setting the `allocPoints`
for each `stakingTokens` and updating the `totalAllocPoint` for the `rewardToken`. The allocation
points of any non-provided staking tokens will be left as-is, and won't be reset to zero.


```solidity
function setAllocPoints(
    address rewardToken,
    IERC20[] calldata stakingTokens,
    uint48[] calldata allocPoints
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The reward token whose allocations are configured|
|`stakingTokens`|`IERC20[]`|The staking tokens to set allocation points for|
|`allocPoints`|`uint48[]`|The allocation points for each staking token|


#### stopReward

Unregisters a reward token fully, immediately preventing users from ever harvesting their pending
accumulated rewards. Optionally `pullTokens` can be set to false which causes the token balance to
not be sent to the owner, this should only be set to false in case the token is bugged and reverts.


```solidity
function stopReward(address rewardToken, address receiver, bool pullTokens) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The reward token to stop|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address that receives the pulled token balance|
|`pullTokens`|`bool`|Whether to transfer the remaining token balance to the receiver|


#### getRewards

Returns the reward pools linked to the `stakingToken` alongside the pending rewards for `user`
for these pools.


```solidity
function getRewards(IERC20 stakingToken, address user) external view returns (address[] memory, uint256[] memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`stakingToken`|`IERC20`|The staking token whose linked reward pools are queried|
|`user`|`address`|The user whose pending rewards are returned|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address[]`|The reward token addresses|
|`<none>`|`uint256[]`|The pending reward amounts, one per reward token|


#### allocPointsByReward

Returns the allocation points for the `rewardToken` over all staking tokens linked to it.


```solidity
function allocPointsByReward(address rewardToken)
    external
    view
    returns (IERC20[] memory stakingTokens, uint48[] memory allocPoints);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The reward token to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`stakingTokens`|`IERC20[]`|The staking tokens linked to the reward token|
|`allocPoints`|`uint48[]`|The allocation points for each staking token|


#### allocPointsByStake

Returns the allocation points for the `stakingToken` over all reward tokens linked to it.


```solidity
function allocPointsByStake(IERC20 stakingToken)
    external
    view
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint48[] memory allocPoints);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`stakingToken`|`IERC20`|The staking token to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The reward tokens linked to the staking token|
|`allocPoints`|`uint48[]`|The allocation points for each reward token|


#### rewardTokens

Returns all enabled reward tokens. Stopped reward tokens are not included, while ended rewards are.


```solidity
function rewardTokens() external view returns (address[] memory);
```

#### rewardDetails

Returns the emission details of a `rewardToken`, configured via `setReward`.


```solidity
function rewardDetails(address rewardToken) external view returns (RewardDetails memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The reward token to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`RewardDetails`|The reward token's emission details|


### Events
#### RewardExtended
Emitted when additional rewards were added to a pool, extending the reward duration.


```solidity
event RewardExtended(address indexed rewardToken, uint256 amountAdded, uint48 newEnd);
```

#### RewardRegistered
Emitted when a reward token has been registered. Can be emitted again for the same token after it has
been explicitly stopped.


```solidity
event RewardRegistered(address indexed rewardToken);
```

#### RewardSet
Emitted when the reward pool has been adjusted or intialized, with the new params.


```solidity
event RewardSet(
    address indexed rewardToken, uint256 amountAdded, uint256 amountPeriod, uint48 start, uint48 duration
);
```

#### RewardsClaimed
Emitted whenever rewards are claimed via the staking pool.


```solidity
event RewardsClaimed(address indexed user, address[] rewardTokens, uint256[] amounts);
```

#### PoolRegistered
Emitted whenever a new staking pool combination was registered via the allocation point adjustment
function.


```solidity
event PoolRegistered(address indexed rewardToken, IERC20 indexed stakeToken);
```

#### AllocPointsSet
Emitted when the owner adjusts the allocation points for pools.


```solidity
event AllocPointsSet(address indexed rewardToken, IERC20[] indexed stakeToken, uint48[] allocPoint);
```

#### RewardStopped
Emitted when a reward token is stopped.


```solidity
event RewardStopped(address indexed rewardToken, address indexed receiver, bool pullTokens);
```

### Errors
#### MultiRewarderRenounceOwnershipDisabled
MultiRewarder renounce ownership is disabled.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderRenounceOwnershipDisabled();
```

#### MultiRewarderDisconnectedStakingToken
The token is not connected to the staking contract, connect it first.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderDisconnectedStakingToken(address token);
```

#### MultiRewarderUnregisteredToken
This token is not registered via `setReward` yet, register it first.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderUnregisteredToken(address token);
```

#### MultiRewarderMaxPoolsForRewardToken
Due to various functions looping over the staking tokens connected to a reward token,
a maximum number of such links is instated.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderMaxPoolsForRewardToken();
```

#### MultiRewarderMaxActiveRewardTokens
Due to various functions looping over the reward tokens connected to a staking token,
a maximum number of such links is instated.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderMaxActiveRewardTokens();
```

#### MultiRewarderPoolFinished
The function can only be called while the pool hasn't ended yet.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderPoolFinished(address rewardToken);
```

#### MultiRewarderZeroDuration
The pool emission duration cannot be set to zero, as this would cause the rewards to be voided.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderZeroDuration();
```

#### MultiRewarderStartInPast
The pool start time cannot be set in the past, as this would cause the rewards to be voided.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderStartInPast(uint256 start);
```

#### MultiRewarderNativeTransferFailed
The recipient failed to handle the receipt of the native tokens, do they have a receipt hook?
If not, use `emergencyWithdraw`.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderNativeTransferFailed(address to, uint256 amount);
```

#### MultiRewarderIncorrectNative
A wrong `msg.value` was provided while setting a native reward, make sure it matches the function
`amount`.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderIncorrectNative(uint256 expected, uint256 actual);
```

#### MultiRewarderZeroRewardRate
Due to a zero input or rounding, the reward rate while setting this pool would be zero,
which is not allowed.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderZeroRewardRate();
```

### Structs
#### RewardDetails
Emission configuration and schedule for a reward token


```solidity
struct RewardDetails {
    uint256 rewardPerSec;
    uint160 totalAllocPoints;
    uint48 start;
    uint48 end;
    bool exists;
}
```



## RewardPool
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/stargate/IMultiRewarder.sol)

Per-pool reward accounting state shared between multiple libraries.

This is an internal struct, placed here as its shared between multiple libraries.


```solidity
struct RewardPool {
uint256 accRewardPerShare;
address rewardToken;
uint48 lastRewardTime;
uint48 allocPoints;
IERC20 stakingToken;
bool removed;
mapping(address => uint256) rewardDebt;
}
```
